question: For an otherwise sound but thin expert answer, how much is enough?
S: half the equally weighted required points; 0/0.5/1 within bundles
O: question-specific thresholds, often lower, sometimes mandatory core-point gates

question: Must the answer name qualified custody as well as separate fund ownership?
Must liquidation advice explain basis recovery and final-distribution loss timing?
Must an answer also mention subsidized investor exits?
O: optional for QL-03; required for QL-29

question: Must the answer explicitly deny a basis step-up and mention reverse cash-flow costs?
Must answers volunteer no guaranteed NAV equality (08) and unchanged shares on exchange trades (09)?
Must the US AP answer name TA acceptance and distinguish market-making eligibility?
Must a broad AP pay/duty answer explain fund transaction charges and possible waivers?
Must cash-dealing answers cover both possible trading costs and realized gains?
O: one consequence plus in-kind contrast suffices

question: Must inventory access through an AP be explicit?
Is a concrete board/provider control contrast needed beyond generic less control?
O: host governance/provider control must be concrete

question: Must budgeting answers allocate organization and excluded costs, beyond saying contracts govern?
recommended_default: O: identify payers; exclusion examples optional

question: Must answers add no sales before effectiveness (18), or fixed-cost/contract context after naming both obligors (21)?
Must no universal split be explicit, or is not inventing one enough?
S: residual economics and no universal split

question: Must all three excluded structures be named?
Must the answer give NBBO median-spread mechanics, table day counts and statement retention?
O: technical point optional; statement retention treated as enrichment

question: Does treating every non-pro-rata basket as custom invalidate an otherwise sound policy answer?
Must index diligence name every contract category (30), and deviation inquiry cover every named dimension (31)?
O: most terms (30); two of three inquiries/two frictions (31)

question: Must answers state constant fees shift the mean, and name dividend timing and diversification limits?
O: variability framing suffices; dividend timing/limits optional

question: Must all five collateral quality/control categories be named?
Must all document placements and procedural details be stated?
O: prospectus plus fewer safeguards (34); shorter placement list (35)

question: Must the exceptional-exit answer say the responsible party determines significant variation?
Must every comparison category appear?
O: six including liquidity and price suffice

question: Must the answer itself adopt class-level currency hedging?
Must cross-subsidy examples say costs are net of transaction charges?
Must 105% be recalled, and is “up to 115%” fatal?
S: 105% required; a ceiling is central error

question: Must the spread answer also mention executable spread/depth?
Must the US/Irish comparison name TA acceptance?
O: called optional but sole omission still partial
recommended_default: S: required; resolve O wording ambiguity

question: Should false ancillary rules automatically make an answer wrong (e.g. mandatory lending agent, new-in-2026 label permission, no exit notification, universal fee recipient)?
S: partial cap unless the recorded central mechanism is reversed
O: broader central-error lists make these wrong
recommended_default: S: local-error cap; central mechanism reversals stay wrong

question: Should a false claim that 6c-11 mandates public PCF posting force wrong?
S: only universal free NSCC access/basket equality explicitly central

question: Is a false notice-start/final-action clock central even when approval is not guaranteed?
S: central anchor says guaranteed final relief
O: wrong starting point/end action themselves central

question: Should either false class-only OR false sub-fund-only restriction force wrong?
S: only sub-fund-only prohibition of class option explicitly anchored
recommended_default: S literal default: class-only error caps partial
